scraped.scraped_description: Aragon gives organizations the tools to build, govern, and accrue value effectively onchain.

name: Aragon
tagline: The Home of Onchain Organizations – governance and ownership infrastructure for DAOs and protocols
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: regulatory uncertainty around DAOs and tokenomics
awards: Recognized as leading DAO governance infrastructure platform
documented_limitations: User experience complexity for non-technical users
failure_modes: Blockchain network congestion affecting governance speed
curation_criteria: Decentralized governance through ANT token holders and community proposals
contributor_governance: Open-source contribution model with community review process
community_ownership: Partial - ANT token holders have governance rights; community-driven development
controversies: Regulatory scrutiny around DAO legal status and liability
Security incidents in DAO governance implementations
legal_regulatory_issues: Ongoing regulatory uncertainty regarding DAO legal status and governance liability across jurisdictions
political_relevance_summary: Addresses gaps in government accountability and public service delivery through technology-enabled civic engagement.

movement_building_utility.notes: Provides direct tools for organizing, campaigning, or mobilizing civic action.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication and adaptation. Already deployed across multiple jurisdictions (48 countries), demonstrating cross-context adaptability.
